title: GIOP: convert to ws_log system
description:
Use the ws_log system instead of custom debug routines. If Wireshark
isn't compiled for the Debug target, the compiler will optimize away all
these calls.

Convert `ws_debug_printf()` calls to `ws_debug()`. Remove leading
function names and trailing newlines from logged messages as those are
handled by the log system.

Convert a `fprintf(stderr,...)` call in an unusual circumstance to
`ws_warning()`.

Ping #19519
